_comment: This tool's references, in citation order: the tool's pages number them [1], [2], ... in this order (IEEE style). Every source has: 'accessed' (ISO date the original was last read and checked; null only for older entries until re-checked), 'ownerCopy' (the owner's private copy: [{"file": ..., "sha256": ...}], or "pending" until it is saved), and either archive entries ({"asset": "<file>"} in the source-archive release, listed in sources/archive.json) or 'noPublicCopy' ({"why": "not-data" | "licence" | "easy-to-get", "note": ...}). Which one: principle 3 in AGENTS.md. Never commit the file itself. Title style: 'quoted' for articles, web pages and parts of books; 'italic' for books, reports and datasets.

sources.usedFor: What the tool uses it for
